What this experience covers

A chauffeured bachelor day typically includes hotel or house pickup, then golf, an activity, or a first confirmed venue, then dinner and additional confirmed stops, late-night food if timing allows, and a scheduled return to one address. Bookings are hourly charters so multi-stop days sit inside one bought window. Share each confirmed venue (and tee time if golfing) plus the intended return time so the team can review the schedule and confirm the service window in writing. Rates and package-style builds are hourly on published minimums — see the bachelor service page and checkout; this page does not invent mystery bundles or dollar figures.

Example itinerary

  1. Pickup at the confirmed hotel or house. Name a trip lead who holds the phone.
  2. Onboard music and beverage plan confirmed by vehicle. Align with house rules before departure.
  3. Golf, activity, or first confirmed venue. Bags and next stop belong in the request if golfing.
  4. Dinner and additional confirmed stops. Keep the list compact enough for the remaining hours.
  5. Late-night food if timing allows.
  6. Scheduled return to the confirmed address.

Frequently asked questions

Can we do a day-into-night bachelor party?

A day-to-night route can be requested. Share each confirmed venue (and tee time if golfing) plus the intended return time so Scottsdale Sprinters can review the schedule and confirm the service window in writing.

Do you do golf course pickups?

Yes when requested. Add the confirmed course, tee time, passenger count, club-bag count, and next stop. The team reviews vehicle fit and route timing before confirming the pickup in writing. See also the golf outing experience and golf service pages.

What if we want to go to multiple bars?

Share the confirmed reservations and preferred stops; the team organizes a practical pickup sequence around venue access, traffic, and the return window on an hourly charter.

What's the best transportation for a bachelor party in Scottsdale?

Most groups book a chauffeured party Sprinter or party bus by the hour, sized to headcount, covering golf and/or Old Town stops with one return plan. Compare units on the bachelor party transportation service page and confirm the total in live checkout.

Can we drink on board a bachelor party vehicle?

Follow published house rules: passengers 21+ may bring their own alcohol only when allowed for that vehicle and stated in the booking terms; Scottsdale Sprinters does not sell alcohol. Read /ride-rules and ask reservations before the night.
